summary: Comprehensive UI/UX Button Audit & Optimization Plan for the Glück application. Covers an exhaustive audit across all screens (Header, BottomNav, LessonControlModal, ArabicParentReportModal, StudentsView, ScheduleView, FinanceView, SchoolScheduleView, HodHubView, SettingsView), establishes a standardized button design system (Primary, Secondary, Tertiary, Icon-only, Destructive, Table/Card, Modal actions), outlines duplicate action consolidations, resolves action placement/hierarchy issues, eliminates dead JSX code, and defines a 4-phase implementation roadmap with testing checklists.
